test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneous spelling is '**Attick**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options the incorrectly spelt word is '**Attick**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Attack**'. • It means 'trying to hurt or defeat somebody/something by using force'. (आक्रमण, हमला) • *Example: The town was under **attack** from all sides.* • Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.** **Correct Answer:__** *Attick.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Aisle**: a passage between the rows of seats in a church, theatre, etc. (चर्च, थिएटर आदि में सीटों के बीच का रास्‍ता; पार्श्ववीथि, मध्यवीथि) • **Adorn**: to add something in order to make a thing or person more attractive or beautiful. (अधिक आकर्षक या मोहक बनाने के लिए सजाना) • **Alter**: to make something different in some way, but without changing it completely; to become different. (आंशिक परिवर्तन करना; बदलना; परिवर्तित होना) 16c:Tbeb, The correct answer is '**Relax**'.
